fee_notes: This is an insurance franchise with a non-traditional royalty structure. Instead of a percentage of gross sales, the franchisor takes 'Retained Commissions' equal to 25% of sales commissions on new business and 45% on renewal business. Minimum Monthly Retained Commission schedule: months 0-5 = $0, months 6-18 = $600/month, months 19+ = $1,000/month. Monthly Technology Fee is $400 for the first user and $225 for each additional user. Brand Fund Fee is 3% of Franchisee Commissions (not gross sales; Franchisee Commissions = total commissions received by Franchisor attributable to Franchisee's Agency after Franchisor deducts its Retained Commission). Additional recurring fees include: E&O/Cyber Policy premium assessment of $226/month (adjusted annually); New Submissions Fee of $100/month (or 1% of monthly Franchisee Commissions if prior-year premium >= $1,250,000). royalty_pct set to null because royalty is a fixed percentage of carrier-paid commissions (not franchisee gross sales), and royalty_min_monthly reflects the 19+ month minimum of $1,000.
raw_excerpt:
Franchisor's Retained Commissions: 25% of sales commissions for new business and 45% of sales commissions for renewal business. Minimum Monthly Retained Commission: months 6-18 = $600, months 19 and beyond = $1,000.

Monthly Technology Fee: $400 for the first user and $225 for each additional user.

Brand Fund Fee: 3% of Franchisee Commissions. Monthly.

Franchisee's E&O and Cyber Policy premium assessment: Initially, $226/month; adjusted annually in February in accordance with the size of your book of business.

New Submissions Fee: $100 per month... if the total amount of premium payments received by Franchisee during the previous calendar year is less than $1,250,000; or (ii) 1% of monthly Franchisee Commission if the total amount of premium payments received by Franchisee during the previous calendar year is equal to or greater than $1,250,000.
